title: Japanese-Style Velvety Stir-Fry
description: A quick and easy stir-fry dish that combines the creaminess of velvety sauce with the bold flavors of Japan.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced bell peppers, carrots, and mushrooms. Stir-fry for 4-5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the velvety sauce and Japanese rice vinegar.
Pour the sauce mixture over the vegetables and stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the sliced green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
